query: SELECT id, name, venue, DATE_FORMAT(startDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as start_time, DATE_FORMAT(endDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as end_time FROM events WHERE venue LIKE '%Spitfire%' OR organizerName LIKE '%Spitfire%' ORDER BY startDate;
